details:
I've just discovered that there is worlds with planes and helicopters to flight with.
In some planes/helicopters there is 2 rounded menus to access differents options.
The issu is that with the right menu (more than 4 options) I can only access to half or less of the options.
I can't go to the far right or far front or far rear.
I have no problem with the left stick.
My friend don't have this issue.
Here is a link to a video i've made, it's more obvious than describe it with words.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9MxFYBX3iP4
I've searched the web for that issu but found noting.
Note:  this issue appear to be present in other world/game that use those rounded menu.
I can't control correctly the right menu/option.
What I've done so far:
- Check game files via Steam
- Check SteamVR files via Steam
- Oculu app uptodate
- Graphic drivers uptodate
- Windows uptodate
Setup:
- Win10 21H2 computer (GTX 1060 6gb, AMD Ryzen 6 3600, RAM 16Gb, SSD 128Gb...)
- Quest 2 VR headset with controllers
- Computer is connected directly to the router
- Quest 2 is connecterd via Wifi 5Ghz to the same router
- Both computer and Quest 2 are up to date.
- VRChat also up to date
Thank you for helping me.
title: Right menu/options controled via thumbstick issue
